task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence by restoring automatic combat audio causality, re-composing and spatially validating the authored cemetery without child-mesh surgery, and qualifying the complete run plus upgrade-choice transaction for direct retest.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has two integration-boundary defects: authoritative lantern attack/impact events do not produce audible Effects-bus output, and the intact cemetery is presented through a mausoleum-heavy, low-contrast composition with weak human-scale route readability. The release flow also remains unqualified end-to-end for the five-wave/boss/result/retry contract and truthful upgrade decision surface.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically modify the intact authored environment or retained runtime audio sources without package incompatibility evidence.
Stop after the three bounded implementation families are complete and their specified runtime recapture matrices are available for Tester.
If a required runtime probe remains unavailable, report missing evidence rather than claiming closure.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause repairs from prior transform-tuning attempts: make audio ownership, stream allocation, bus routing, and lifecycle explicit; make world composition and spatial integrity scene/contract-owned around one intact authored package with additive datum/collision/navigation; and complete the authoritative run transaction/UI contract instead of adding presentation-only tuning.

code: Parse and statically inspect edited Godot scripts/scenes; verify referenced nodes, resources, InputMap actions, bus names, and reset signals resolve without new errors.
White-box retest spatial bindings, audio event ownership/stream allocation, draft projection limits and placeholders, run-state transitions, and reset generations.
runtime: Tester recaptures camera movement/dash at spawn, central landmark, critical route, and boundary/perimeter during ordinary movement/movement replay, including collision and occlusion/disappearance checks.
Tester performs a fresh Effects-bus capture across automatic lantern onset, legal-hit impact, miss, pause/reset, and retry, correlating waveform energy with source timestamps and duplicate counts.

Tester performs Title → Play → guidance dismissal → waves/upgrades → Bellkeeper victory/result → Retry, plus natural failure/result, and verifies clean replay with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus probes.
visual: Capture shipped high-angle gameplay at spawn, route, central building/landmark, external world/depth, and dense-wave states; compare warm/cool hierarchy, human scale, escape lanes, perimeter readability, collision alignment, and absence of disappearance/occlusion drift.

Capture upgrade draft, pause, victory/failure result, retry, and title states at configured viewport and UI scale; verify icon-led hierarchy, truthful current-to-new deltas, focus states, readable full-viewport composition, and no clipped labels.

done_when: The cemetery remains one intact authored environment instance; native streets, terrain, buildings, props, materials, and landmarks are not copied, hidden, extracted, or repositioned.

The playable footprint is expanded to a larger traversable scale where native geometry supports it, with coherent external world/depth beyond the play space and no proxy floor presented as finished art.

The central building/landmark set (mausoleum, keeper lantern post, cracked bell) is balanced in the high-angle shipped camera with readable human-scale Warden framing, warm lantern versus cool moonlight hierarchy, and a clear escape lane.
Visible geometry and collision agree at the central building/landmark and along the boundary/perimeter; no floating, intersecting, invisible, or pass-through blockers are introduced.

An ordinary movement/movement replay from spawn through a route and perimeter view shows no disappearance or occlusion drift of the Warden, threats, or landmarks; camera-aware transparency/sight-lane handling is bounded and reset-safe.
Spatial contract state exposes stable spawn, objective, navigation, collision, boundary, and landmark bindings for Tester recapture.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authored cemetery presentation and spatial contract at the scene/world boundary. Rebind spawn, objective, navigation, collision, camera coverage, and occlusion handling to the intact authored package; use additive outer datum and gameplay anchors only where needed. Recompose lighting, landmark exposure, sight lanes, and readable escape routes at the shipped high-angle camera instead of repeating camera transform tweaks. Preserve ordinary movement, dash, and collision behavior while making perimeter and external-depth evidence inspectable.
tasks.title: Restore authored cemetery composition and spatial integrity

done_when: Every automatic Warden Lantern attack emits a non-silent, bounded onset and, for a legal hit, impact transient on the Effects bus, causally aligned with authoritative attack phases.
A fresh Effects capture has measurable waveform energy for onset and impact while an independent Effects control remains audible; Master and Effects receipts identify semantic source and bus.
Exactly one onset and one impact are emitted per attack event, with no duplicate replay from generic bolt/VFX paths; miss, concrete hit, and material cues remain distinguishable and bounded.
Audio continues through normal wave density, stops on pause/result/retry lifecycle reset, and leaves no stale voices or altered weapon cadence.
The audio director exposes event timestamps, stream/resource paths, bus names, gain/envelope, and reset receipts for direct white-box retest.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned audio adapter at the semantic ownership boundary. Trace attack_runtime and Warden Lantern events into the audio director, ensure authored onset/impact streams are allocated and routed to Effects before events arrive, and fix voice lifecycle/envelope/reset behavior causing silent captures. Keep combat timing and retained source assets unchanged; prevent generic bolt presentation from replaying the complete player cue. Add only bounded instrumentation needed to correlate event ids with mixed-output receipts.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern Effects-bus causality

done_when: Starting at Title and choosing Play enters a clean authoritative run with the Warden Lantern equipped; first-run guidance teaches movement, dash, automatic attack, pickup collection, and the first upgrade in the real arena, is dismissible, does not consume combat input, and does not reappear on retry.

Experience drops settle, attract, and resolve exactly once with visible meter interpolation and sound; each level threshold opens one paused three-choice draft, preserves overflow, applies the selected upgrade before resume, and cannot reroll or duplicate under held confirm.

Each upgrade choice leads with a recognizable weapon/upgrade silhouette or authored icon, uses compact stat icons, shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, omits unchanged/exhaustive rows, never shows NEW or LOCKED in CURRENT, and has distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed/selected states with debounced confirmation.

A successful ordinary run survives five escalating waves, includes composition change and elite pressure, defeats the Bellkeeper with telegraph, two phases, and vulnerable recovery, then reaches a result screen containing outcome, time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt/taken, selected upgrades, build summary, Retry, and Title.

Failure reaches the same result contract, while Retry and Return to Title reset actors, director state, upgrades, pickups, audio, pause ownership, input focus, and HUD without stale state; a subsequent run is playable through ordinary movement and automatic combat.
All three weapon identities and all four ordinary enemy archetypes are observable in authoritative run state and shipped HUD.
tasks.instructions: Close the end-to-end release contract at the authoritative run controller, upgrade transaction, and product shell. Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy: silhouettes or authored icons first, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, no NEW or LOCKED placeholder in CURRENT, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states. Exercise and repair title-to-play, guidance, wave/director, level-up pause/choice/apply/resume, Bellkeeper victory and natural failure, result presentation, retry/title reset, and input-focus ownership as one lifecycle. Keep deterministic tester preparation isolated from release actions and expose receipts for setup, draft serial, application, result, and reset generation.
tasks.title: Qualify complete run and replace text-stacked upgrade choices
